question: If an earthquake happens at the sea floor and one tectonic plate dips under the another, this will most probably lead to a natural disaster known as:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tsunami**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• An earthquake occurring at the sea floor, especially when one tectonic plate dips under another, can displace a large volume of water.
 
• This displacement creates waves that travel across the ocean at high speeds, known as a **tsunami**.
